[ASSISTANT_SAID] Protein powder is essential for muscle repair and growth; it is a convenient way to increase protein intake.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Creatine is one of the most researched supplements for building muscle, increasing strength, power, and size.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] BCAAs (branched-chain amino acids) promote muscle growth, reduce fatigue, and improve endurance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Beta-alanine increases muscular endurance and delays fatigue during high-intensity exercise.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Nitric oxide boosters increase blood flow, improving muscle pump and recovery.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Glutamine reduces muscle breakdown and improves recovery.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Supplements should not be the sole source of nutrition; a balanced diet and exercise are essential for bodybuilding.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pre-workout supplements often contain caffeine, amino acids, and other ingredients to enhance energy, focus, and endurance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pre-workout supplements can improve performance but should be used with a balanced diet and exercise routine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Caution is advised with pre-workout supplements due to potential high levels of caffeine and stimulants; consulting a healthcare professional is recommended.
